description: This file defines the DVB EIT (Event Information Table) class and its nested ServiceIterator class, including constants, enums, and methods for parsing and handling DVB EIT data related to broadcast services.

classes.name: Thunder::Broadcast::DVB::EIT
classes.description: Represents the DVB Event Information Table, providing methods to access service information, transport stream ID, and related data.

classes.name: Thunder::Broadcast::DVB::EIT::ServiceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing services within an EIT, providing access to service-specific data such as service ID, running mode, and descriptors.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next service.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::ServiceId
methods.description: Returns the service ID of the current service.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the descriptors associated with the current service.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::RunningMode
methods.description: Returns the running mode of the service.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::EIT_PF
methods.description: Indicates if the service is a present/following event.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::EIT_Schedule
methods.description: Indicates if the service is scheduled.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::IsFreeToAir
methods.description: Indicates if the service is free-to-air.

methods.name: EIT::ServiceIterator::DescriptorSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the current descriptor.

methods.name: EIT::TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID associated with the EIT.

methods.name: EIT::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID from the EIT data.

methods.name: EIT::Services
methods.description: Returns the number of services in the EIT.
